label: **IWantAds** — one click toggles your IWA extension group, or auto on allowlisted sites (e.g. Stripe).
**Pick extensions:** right-click the IWantAds button in the sidebar (or Shift+click). Check the ad-blockers / privacy extensions you want in the group, then Save.
Auto-disable IWA extensions when the selected tab is on an allowlisted host
Hosts, one per line (or comma). `stripe.com` matches itself and `*.stripe.com`.
